stories.title: 'I would rather die than return to France': the brutal reality of the UK's one-in-one-out scheme
stories.summary: More than a thousand asylum seekers have been selected by the Home Office, apparently at random, to be returned to France under the UK's one-in-one-out scheme. The Guardian reports on the human impact of this policy.

stories.title: Home Office Crowborough camp plans 'bypass' council
stories.summary: Government plans to extend the use of a former military training camp in East Sussex to house asylum seekers will bypass the local council, the local authority has said.

stories.title: New 24-week target on asylum appeal decisions comes into force
stories.summary: Individuals with no right to be in the UK will be deported faster as a new 24-week target on asylum appeal decisions comes into force.

stories.title: UK summons Russian Chargé d'Affaires after reckless attack on Leipzig airport
stories.summary: The UK's Foreign, Commonwealth & Development Office summoned the Russian Chargé d'Affaires following what the UK described as a reckless attack on Leipzig airport, in a major diplomatic statement.

stories.title: Mental health support guidance published for British nationals in Venezuela
stories.summary: The FCDO published new guidance providing mental health support information for British nationals in Venezuela.

stories.title: DWP launches consultation on Guaranteed Minimum Pensions Fixed Rate Revaluation
stories.summary: The Department for Work and Pensions published a consultation on Guaranteed Minimum Pensions Fixed Rate Revaluation, seeking views on how GMPs should be revalued for deferred members.

stories.title: Consultation on Occupational Pension Schemes (Contracted-out) Amendment Regulations 2026
stories.summary: DWP is seeking views on draft regulations that provide for the conversion of Guaranteed Minimum Pensions (GMPs) into other scheme benefits.

agencies.name: DEFRA
agencies.description: Department for Environment, Food & Rural Affairs

stories.title: DEFRA publishes Statistical Work Programme for 2026/27
stories.summary: DEFRA released its statistical work plan for 2026/27, setting out current and emerging user needs for environmental, agricultural, and rural statistics.

stories.title: MoD backs UK startup Black Crow's fan-powered wing system for special ops
stories.summary: The UK Ministry of Defence invested over $6 million behind efforts to develop a fan-powered wing system created by UK startup Black Crow, aimed at special operations missions.

stories.title: Conservatives outline plan to boost UK defence spending to 3% of GDP by 2030
stories.summary: The Conservative Party announced how it would fund a £10bn per year uplift in defence spending to reach 3% of GDP by 2030, saying the military 'can't operate on warm words'.

agencies.name: BIST
agencies.description: Department for Business, Innovation, Science and Trade

stories.title: Nearly 660 employers named as failing to pay the National Minimum Wage
stories.summary: BIST and the Fair Work Agency published a list of nearly 660 employers found to have failed to pay workers the National Minimum Wage, with Business Secretary Jonathan Reynolds MP warning that short-changing staff is not a shortcut to success.

stories.title: Independent regulatory review of the Office of Rail and Road published
stories.summary: An independent review set out an achievable pathway for the Office of Rail and Road (ORR) to evolve from a respected regulator into a more strategic organisation, relevant to BIST's oversight of business and trade regulatory bodies.

stories.title: Intellectual Property Office publishes Corporate Plan for 2026-2027
stories.summary: The Intellectual Property Office published its Corporate Plan for 2026 to 2027, setting out its priorities and commitments for the year ahead.

stories.title: CGI wins NHS Login support contract
stories.summary: IT services firm CGI has won a contract to provide support for the NHS Login service, the digital identity platform used by millions of patients to access NHS digital services.

stories.title: NHS England Digital launches Cyber Security Awareness Month 2026
stories.summary: NHS England Digital is preparing for Cyber Security Awareness Month 2026, highlighting the importance of cybersecurity as the NHS transitions from analogue to digital systems.
